issues.reason: Class-targeted favored rewards remain manual until referenced class feature IDs and fractional accumulations are reconciled.

Magic Ineptitude forbids obtaining an MP pool; current wizard Black Mage automatically computes MP. Immortal + Black Mage class selection is mechanically conflicting and must be reviewed manually; do NOT infer a spellcasting exception.

The baseline adapter supports a chosen +2 ability, up to four Knowledge class skills and bounded starting bonus languages. Heritage replacements, favored rewards and independent rule review remain unresolved.
Source prose says one variant but TABLE has two: Ancients and Unlimited. Unlimited WIS/CHA selection and both replacement rules need explicit choice routing.
Linking, Spirit-Tapped, Undying and antimagic unconsciousness require custom state/actions and remain manual.

features.name: Ability Score Adjustment
features.description: Choose exactly one of STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS or CHA for a +2 racial bonus at creation. A selected score is not automatically assigned until the player makes this choice.

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium size; no size-based adjustments.

effects.textValue: Medium

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with immortal subtype.

effects.textValue: Humanoid (immortal)

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 30-foot land speed.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Starts speaking Common. High-Intelligence options: Celestial, Draconic, Galkan, Goblin, Lalafellan, Mithran, Orc.

effects.textValue: Common

features.name: Immunity to Death
features.description: Immune to death spells and death effects, including Death.

effects.textValue: Death spells and effects

features.name: Immunity to Undeath
features.description: Cannot be raised as an undead by effects such as Animate Dead.

effects.textValue: Immune to being raised as undead

features.name: Integrated
features.description: +1 racial bonus on Bluff, Disguise and Knowledge (local) checks.

features.name: Long-Lived
features.description: At creation select UP TO four distinct Knowledge skills; each becomes a class skill.

effects.textValue: Up to four chosen Knowledge skills become class skills

features.name: Sociable
features.description: After failing Diplomacy to change attitude by 5 or more, may retry even if 24 hours have not passed.

effects.textValue: Retry attitude adjustment after failure by >=5 despite 24-hour restriction

features.name: Linking
features.description: Once per day as a full-round action link with one WILLING non-Immortal spellcaster. Gain access to one spell from that spellcaster’s known spells as a spell-like ability during the day. Spell must have casting time <= standard action, spell level <= half Immortal character level, and the Immortal must meet the needed mental score. The source does not specify some spell choice and activation details.

effects.textValue: 1/day full-round link to one willing non-Immortal caster; choose single qualified known spell <= floor(character level/2), mental-stat qualification, standard-or-faster; spell-like activation within day

features.name: Immortal
features.description: Do not gain age-category benefits or penalties; stop aging before middle age, immune to age attacks. Disease/natural causes may still kill the creature.

effects.textValue: Age-category adjustments suppressed; immune to effects that age target

features.name: Spirit-Tapped
features.description: Upon dropping to negative HP at or below CON score, instead of dying gain one permanent negative level and enter a special dead state, fast-healing equal to half character level until 0+ HP, stacking no higher than character level minus one negative levels. Once limit reached remain inert until healed of a negative level. Dismemberment, vorpal and 0 CON can still kill.

effects.textValue: Special dying/dead state at negative HP <= CON; negative levels; conditional fast healing; cap and exceptions; GM/manual

features.name: Undying
features.description: At exactly 0 HP disabled but can take one move OR standard action each round without strenuous-action HP damage. At -1 or less automatically stabilize, but further damage may kill.

effects.textValue: At 0 HP disabled one action no extra loss; at negative HP auto stabilize without immunity to death

features.name: Magic Ineptitude
features.description: Cannot obtain a magic pool (MP); cannot use spell-trigger, spell-completion, command-word, or use-activated magic items except via Linking. Exceptions: alchemical items; activating/deactivating own magic weapons and armor; passive static bonuses from magical wondrous items/rings.

effects.textValue: No magic pool and forbidden item activation except source-listed exceptions/Linking; blocks ordinary Black Mage MP

features.name: Not of this Plane
features.description: If successfully dispelled while no active effects are present (dispel DC 10 + HD + WIS modifier), knocked unconscious for rounds equal to opponent caster level. Anti-magic field causes unconsciousness until leaving. Also subject to spells negatively affecting outsiders or summons.

effects.textValue: Conditional dispel DC 10+HD+WIS mod; unconscious for enemy CL rounds; anti-magic unconscious while present; outsider/summon-targeted negative spells apply

features.name: Background Character
features.description: +1 racial Disguise, Knowledge (dungeoneering), Stealth; replaces Integrated.

features.name: Blank Slate
features.description: 1/day free action: for one skill check use ranks equal to half character level (minimum 1). Replaces Long-Lived.

effects.textValue: Once per day one check ranks max(1,floor(character level/2))

features.name: Explorer
features.description: +2 racial Acrobatics, Climb and Swim; all three become class skills; replaces Long-Lived.

effects.textValue: acrobatics class skill
climb class skill
swim class skill

features.name: Emissary
features.description: 1/day roll two dice for one Bluff OR Diplomacy check and use higher; replaces Sociable.

effects.textValue: Once/day roll twice for single Bluff or Diplomacy check; use higher
